_instructions.description: Template for the Vault records consumed by External Secrets Operator. Replace every <...> placeholder before applying.
_instructions.apply: For each key below, create or update a KV v2 secret at the path and keep the field names unchanged.
_instructions.generated_values: Use a password manager or a cryptographically secure generator for passwords, cookies, keys, client secrets and tokens.
excluded_from_this_file: TLS secrets created by cert-manager (for example *-tls and sesc-internal-ca-secret)
Vault unseal keys and root token
Grafana and MinIO docker-compose environment variables outside Kubernetes

conditional.apps/registry: Required only when apps/registry/values.yaml sets auth.enabled to true. HTPASSWD must be generated with htpasswd -Bbn <user> <password>.
conditional.prod/lyceum-auth: The current chart values point to apps/lyceum-auth, while the template itself contains a prod/lyceum-auth path. Keep this path only if another deployed revision still references it; otherwise use apps/lyceum-auth.

cross_references.apps/authentik.SPRAVKI_CLIENT_ID: Must match the client configured by the Authentik Spravki blueprint.
cross_references.apps/authentik.TECHNICAL_SUPPORT_CLIENT_: Must match the client configured by the Authentik Technical Support blueprint.
cross_references.apps/authentik.AUTH_ADMIN_APP_CLIENT_ID: Must match the client configured by the Authentik Auth Admin blueprint.
cross_references.apps/lyceum-auth-admin.CLIENT_ID: Use the Auth Admin client ID from apps/authentik.
cross_references.apps/lyceum-auth-admin.CLIENT_SECRET: Use the Auth Admin client secret from apps/authentik.
cross_references.apps/lyceum-auth.SA_AUTH_ADMIN_APP_API_T: Use the same service-account API token as apps/authentik.SA_AUTH_ADMIN_APP_API_TOKEN.
